title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.2 (Peaked November 09, 2026 at 13:16 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 707 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Hold onto something! 🌀🌌👀

Several bright active regions and a central sunspot group stand out today, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward CME.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
